description.narrative: The objective of the HPMP - Stage III is to develop the third stage of a Compliance Strategy and corresponding Action Plan for the substances controlled under Annex C Group I (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, for the period 2015 to 2020, such that the consumption of HCFCs is reduced by 67.5% from the baseline in 2025. Preparation of a HCFC phase-out management plan (stage III)NIR/PHA/83/PRP/153
